ctx.x: Yeah, like Leon Parr, George Raft, oh, the stars, you know, that was stars back in them days. All of them, when they come to Chicago, they'd come by the Grand Terrace.
There was also something that I read in the Earl Hines book, that Sunday was called celebrity night.
